review.explicit_pin: Source report raw SHA equals caller Dataset Manifest sha256; canonical Registry manifest is separately snapshotted by old core.
review.report_contract: RAW/STAGED document only; caller explicitly supplies version/source/license/access/spatial/temporal/lineage; no auto-creation or semantic certification.
review.file_checks: Every completed source row requires image,label,quality local file and SHA; legacy window-state evidence must resolve to row artifact.
review.path_checks: DATA confinement and remote/UNC rejection; original logical source/report paths re-resolved before register; target stat and report raw SHA checked again.
review.source_JSON_bounds: registry manifest1MiB/report and state64MiB/20000 scenes; duplicate keys/nonfinite/non-object/UTF8 failure rejected. Byte/file bounds are not cumulative CPU or source-file IO budgets.
review.registry_write: One common dataset_versions transaction via old register_version; no legacy datasets write in explicit new branch; same manifest idempotent and conflict rejected.
review.lineage: Direct immutable parent resolution only; not full transitive DAG/ACL proof.
review.CLI_legacy: Omitting registry-manifest preserves old namespace/response/record path under source-pinned comparison test.
review.store_initialization: Explicit CLI may create DB/schema before later registration rejection; not a read-only CLI. No existing Job recovery when recover_jobs=False.
review.UI_reason: No endpoint or frontend schema changed. Explicit CLI only; no operating record registered and no new UI state. Future source document listing must retain RAW/STAGED/noQA semantics.

limitations: Source hash success does not parse raster pixels, verify label year/taxonomy, class7, quality, AOI/temporal semantics, scientific accuracy or training eligibility.
DatasetVersion object is the report document; images are not registered as immutable copies and DB/file atomic snapshot is not provided.
No provenance/authority certification from caller manifest or direct-parent hash match.
